context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase S1 Staffing Module fully functional. Backend endpoints: /api/staffing/shift-templates (CRUD + apply), /api/staffing/shifts/{id}/move, /api/staffing/conflicts, /api/staffing/workforce-dashboard. Frontend: StaffingConsole has 12 tabs (Dashboard, Rota, Templates, Staff, Time Off, Shift Market, Performance, Payroll, Live Floor, Rules, Announcements, AI Insights). Dashboard tab shows 6 KPIs (Active Staff, On Shift Now, Running Late, Absent, Open Today, Coverage), week totals row (Scheduled Hours, Labour Cost, Overtime, Avg/Hour), and 7x24 coverage heatmap. Templates tab shows empty state with 'New template' button that opens editor modal with all fields (Name, Role, Break, Start/End time, Weekdays checkboxes, Default Staff, Colour). Rota tab has grid with week navigation and 'Copy to next week' button.
